#nullable enable
using LoadEmployees.Csv;
using LoadEmployees.TestDoubles;
using Xunit;

namespace LoadEmployees.Tests;

public class EmployeeCsvRowSourceTests
{
    [Fact]
    public async Task ReadAsync_ReadsEveryRow_FromTheSampleFile()
    {
        using var harness = new PackageHarness();
        var package = harness.Package();
        var source = package.FF_SRC_Employees();

        var rows = new List<EmployeeCsvRow>();
        await foreach (var row in source.ReadAsync(CancellationToken.None)) rows.Add(row);

        Assert.Equal(2, rows.Count);
        var first = rows[0];
        Assert.Equal(7, first.EmployeeID);
        Assert.Equal("Sample", first.FirstName);
        Assert.Equal("Sample", first.LastName);
        Assert.Equal("Sample", first.Department);
        Assert.Equal(DateOnly.Parse("2020-06-15", System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), first.HireDate);
        Assert.Equal(7.5m, first.Salary);
        Assert.Equal("Sample", first.City);
        Assert.Equal("Sa", first.State);
    }
}
